name: GM Shield
description: Protection is supplied through Shield Up and Shield Bash.

orders.name: Shield Up
orders.description: Gain +2 Shielding dice until the end of the current round.

counterattacks.name: Shield Bash
counterattacks.trigger: After an enemy declares a ranged attack from a normal order against another operational allied Gunpla, before attack dice or interception rolls. The shooter must be within 2 inches of the equipped suit and in torso-to-torso line of sight.
counterattacks.effect: Cancel that one pending ranged attack step (the step is spent). Resolve the counterattack's heat check, then the enemy finishes any remaining legal steps and applies normal activation heat.
